रेजडयो टेलीफोन ऑपरेटर (जनबंजधत) प्र माणपत्र और लाइसेंस को जनलंजबत या रद्द करना 6. जनयम 16 का उप-जनयम (2) और (4) िनजहत में रेजडयो टेलीफोन ऑपरेटर (जनबंजधत) प्र माणपत्र और लाइसेंस को जनलंजबत या रद्द करना Adhiniyam, 2024 (16 of 2024), the Central Government hereby authorises the officers specified in column (1) of the First Schedule annexed hereto to exercise such of the powers (more specifically described in the second schedule annexed hereto) as are specified in the corresponding entries in column (2) of the said First Schedule. FIRST SCHEDULE S. No. Designation of the Officer Powers in the Second Schedule to be exercised (1) (2) (3) 1. Director General of Civil Aviation All -- 2 of 3 -- [भाग II—खण्ड 3(ii)] भारत का रािपत्र : असाधारण 3 2. Joint Director General of Civil Aviation 1, 2 , 3, 4, 5, 6 3. Deputy Director General of Civil Aviation 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 4. Director of Operations, Radio Telephone Operator (Restricted) Division 1 5. Deputy Director of Operations, Radio Telephone Operator (Restricted) Division 1 SECOND SCHEDULE S.No. Rule of the Radio Telephone Operator (Restricted) Certificate and Licence Rules, 2025 by which power is conferred Nature of power (1) (2) (3) 1. rule 5 To grant or extend a Radio Telephone Operator (Restricted) Certificate and Licence. 2. sub-rule (1) of rule 15 To disqualify a person from holding or obtaining a Radio Telephone Operator (Restricted) Certificate and Licence 3. sub-rule (2) of rule 15 To debar a person permanently or temporarily from holding a Radio Telephone Operator (Restricted) Certificate and Licence in the public interest. 4. sub-rule (3) of rule 15 and Sub-rules (1) & (3) of rule 16 To require the holder to surrender the Radio Telephone Operator (Restricted) Certificate and Licence. 5. sub-rule (1) of rule 16 To suspend or cancel a Radio Telephone Operator (Restricted) Certificate and Licence 6. sub-rules (2) and (4) of rule 16 To suspend or cancel a Radio Telephone Operator (Restricted) Certificate and Licence in the public interest. [F. No. AV/25/2023-DG] SHOBHIT GUPTA, Jt. Secy.
